content: HealthKit does not work in Expo Go at all; requires a custom dev client via expo-dev-client and npx expo prebuild. @kingstinct/react-native-healthkit also requires react-native-nitro-modules. Config plugin adds NSHealthShareUsageDescription and NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription to Info.plist and entitlements com.apple.developer.healthkit. EAS build syncs capabilities automatically but known issue #2117 shows provisioning profiles can be stale/cached causing build failure with 'profile doesn't support HealthKit capability'. HealthKit only works on physical devices (not simulator). Entitlements must be in ios.entitlements object directly, not in a modifier, for EAS capability sync to work.
